<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and processes users.

This module provides functionality to add users and determine if they are adults. It logs whether each user is an adult or a minor based on their age. The `UserManager` class is responsible for managing user data within the system.

@attribute {User[]} users - Array of users managed by the `UserManager`. Each user is an instance of the `User` class.
</DOCSTRING>
